summary: All three phases delivered their stated objectives. Phase-01 touched two files outside its declared lists: tests/integration/gitDiffNameStatus.test.ts (justified — a snapshot had to be updated to match the new deleteBranch argv) and .agents/skills/phax-planning/SKILL.md (disclosed in handoff as a prior-run artifact; content appears correct but warrants human confirmation). Phase-02 and phase-03 are fully conformant with no deviations. All commit subjects match the plan exactly. The run is conformant overall.

findings.message: Delivered as specified. BranchNameSchema tightened with minLength(1), maxLength(255), and a Schema.filter using isSafeBranchName rejecting empty, leading-dash, and ASCII whitespace/control inputs. -- separators added to createBranch, branchExists, deleteBranch, addWorktree, removeWorktree, and pushBranch. BranchName brand type and decodeBranchName signature unchanged.

All required unit-test cases present in tests/unit/branded.test.ts: regression accepts (main, feature/my-thing, dots, slashes, mid-string dash) and rejections (empty, -x, --upload-pack=x, leading space, embedded space/tab, null byte, \x01 control char).

tests/integration/gitDiffNameStatus.test.ts was modified but not in the planned file lists. A command-string snapshot asserting 'git branch -d missing-branch' was updated to 'git branch -d -- missing-branch' to match the new deleteBranch argv. Justified: required to keep the gate green and directly caused by the planned adapter change.

.agents/skills/phax-planning/SKILL.md was modified but is outside this phase's scope. Handoff attributes it to a prior incomplete run of this phase. Content appears complete and well-formed. Deviation is disclosed; human review of the file content is recommended.

BranchName brand type and decodeBranchName signature unchanged. All callers (resolveRunInfo.ts, resetPhase.ts, worktree.ts, executePlan.ts, git adapter) unaffected. isSafeBranchName is correctly module-private.
No changes to WorktreePath, Namespace, or ShortName schemas. No changes to branch-name generation in the app layer. No shell-based git path or changes to the execFile invocation model.
Commit subject 'fix(git): reject option-like branch names and separate git operands with --' matches the plan exactly.

Covers all required content: final BranchNameSchema pattern, enumeration of commands with and without --, confirmation that main and feature/my-thing are accepted, and explicit disclosure of both file deviations with reasons.

Delivered exactly. scripts/docs-cli.ts imports execFileSync and invokes it as execFileSync('usage', ['generate', 'markdown', '-f', specPath, '--out-file', refPath], { stdio: 'inherit' }). Surrounding README-splicing logic is untouched.
No unit test exists for this dev script, consistent with the plan's test strategy. Verification via typecheck, lint, and knip under the full gate.
Only scripts/docs-cli.ts was touched, matching the plan exactly.
Commit subject 'refactor(scripts): invoke usage via execFileSync instead of interpolated execSync' matches the plan exactly.
Confirms execFileSync replaces execSync, behavioral equivalence, and no file-plan deviations.
Delivered exactly. All nine uses: lines across ci.yml and release.yml were pinned to the full commit SHAs from the plan table, with trailing # <tag> comments. No other lines modified.
Gate passes trivially for a workflow-only edit, as stated in the plan's test strategy. CI on the PR is the real verification signal.
Only .github/workflows/ci.yml and .github/workflows/release.yml were touched, matching the plan exactly.
No scope reduction on contents:write / id-token:write permissions. No Dependabot config, workflow linter, or changes to the usage CLI download step.
Commit subject 'ci: pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs' matches the plan exactly.
Includes a full change table with old tags and new SHAs, explicitly notes the gate passed trivially and CI is the real signal, and confirms no file-plan deviations.
